title: High-legibility onboarding assets: dark-mode contrast audit & iconography harmonization
creator: Liam Carter
description: Scope: perform a contrast and iconography pass across all onboarding and quickstart UX assets used in the welcome flows, first-time setup modals, and docs quickstart screenshots. Deliver a minimal, production-ready asset set (Figma components + exported annotated screenshots) and a short implementation guide for engineering that uses existing design tokens where possible. Goals: raise legibility in dark mode to meet WCAG AA for normal text, harmonize icon stroke weights and semantic colors so icons remain distinguishable at small sizes, and reduce cognitive overhead for new users across light/dark themes.
acceptance_criteria: All onboarding screens meet WCAG AA contrast ratios for normal text (>= 4.5:1)
Primary CTA text and instructional copy meet >= 4.5:1 in both light and dark themes
All icons used in onboarding are provided as scalable SVGs with 2 theme-aware variants (light/dark) or adaptable strokes/fills
Design tokens or CSS variable mappings identified for each adjusted color
A delivered Figma file with annotated screens and an exports folder with 1x and 2x PNG screenshots for release notes
Engineering PR references implementation guide and token names and is linked from this ticket
deliverables: Exported screenshots: welcome, create-api-key, run-quickstart, sample-output (light/dark, 1x/2x)
comments: 2026-02-25 Liam Carter: Kickoff — scoped screens and compiled initial inventory (36 assets). Prioritized welcome flow, create-api-key, and first-run quickstart for MVP.
2026-03-01 Priya Shah: First pass in Figma completed. Raised background-foreground deltas for code blocks in dark mode; proposed using secondary surface token for contrast anchor.

2026-03-03 Diego Ramos (Engineering): Noted limitation with current token naming — will land token aliases in ENG-2110 before PR for implementation. Suggested a light overlay for card surfaces to avoid reflow changes.
2026-03-06 PM review: Ask to prefer semantic status colors (success/warn/error) that keep >=3:1 with primary text in dark theme — acceptance criteria updated.

2026-03-09 Accessibility review (external consultant): Recommend increasing icon stroke weight by 0.5px for sizes <=16px and adding dot indicators for ambiguous glyphs. Marked high priority for small-screen legibility.
2026-03-10 Priya Shah: Updated Figma with new icon variants and exported initial dark-mode screenshots. Ready for engineering QA pairing next week.
2026-03-10 Link to implementation PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/web/pull/2345 — includes CSS variable map and sample screenshot assets.
notes: Trade-offs: prefer token aliasing to adding new low-level tokens to minimize impact across products. For a few legacy illustrations where recoloring would break brand, we will add a subtle background plate in dark mode instead of recoloring. Icons are being harmonized to a single 1.5px stroke baseline with optional filled variants for semantic actions.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Small text on low-contrast backgrounds in dark mode on older OLED panels — Mitigation: enforce minimum text size for critical labels and provide a filtered overlay option
Risk: Engineering bandwidth for token rollout — Mitigation: provide clear token alias table and fallbacks; coordinate with ENG-2110
